title: Consulting partner
description:
Confira a vaga para Consulting partner em boa vista. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

ERA Group, a global leader in cost management and business optimisation, is looking for an entrepreneurial Partner to join our international network of consultants. This is not a traditional consultancy role; it's a chance to run your own practice within a global brand, with the freedom to shape your market, build your team, and grow your client base while backed by ERA's proven methodologies, tools, and worldwide community. What You'll Do Lead cost optimisation, procurement, and performance improvement programmes across industries Build and grow your client portfolio through business development and long-term partnerships Take ownership of your practice's strategic direction, go-to-market approach, and team leadership Work directly with C-level clients to deliver measurable savings and transformation What You Bring Extensive consulting or senior leadership experience in cost management, procurement, or performance improvement A strong track record of client acquisition and project delivery Deep expertise in one or more industries such as Pharma/Life Sciences, Energy/Utilities, Manufacturing, Consumer, or Logistics Confidence in engaging with Cx O-level stakeholders and leveraging your professional network An entrepreneurial mindset with the ambition to grow a successful consulting practice This is the ideal next step if you're seeking less bureaucracy, more independence, and the chance to build something of your own within a global consultancy platform. title: Ai automation specialist
description:
Empresa está contratando Ai automation specialist em rio branco. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Hey, Dingus! Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, systems-minded AI Automation Specialist who can build, connect, and scale intelligent workflows that actually work in production. About Us Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an "unlimited get-shit-done" subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between. Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading. What You'll Do Build and maintain automated workflows using N8 N, connecting APIs, webhooks, and data sources into seamless pipelines. Integrate and prompt Claude (Anthropic) and other LLMs into production systems, not just experiments. Manage and automate data operations in Airtable, including scripted fields, automations, and structured data pipelines. Design AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort across client delivery, internal ops, and content production. Troubleshoot broken pipelines, handle edge cases, and document systems so they don't live only in your head. Collaborate with strategy and delivery teams to identify automation opportunities and scope builds accurately. Stay current on the AI tooling landscape, you should know what's worth using before we ask. Own and iterate on AI agent logic and system prompts, understanding why a workflow behaves the way it does and improving it over time. Build net-new internal AI tools as the business identifies opportunities, not just maintain what exists. What You Bring 2+ years of hands-on experience building automated workflows (N8 N, , or Zapier, N8 N strongly preferred). Real experience integrating LLMs via API (Claude, GPT, or equivalent) into production pipelines with structured outputs. Proficiency in Airtable as a data layer, scripting, automations, relational structures. Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and webhook-based integrations. Basic scripting ability in Python or Java Script, enough to write and debug function nodes without hand-holding. A working understanding of HTML and CSS is imperative, you need to be able to read, interpret, and make sense of front-end structure when workflows touch web-based outputs. A systems thinker mindset: you design the whole loop, not just the happy path. Ability to work independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment. Comfort with versioning and testing AI outputs, you notice when a prompt change breaks something and know how to fix it. Bonus Points Experience with vector databases or basic RAG pipelines (Pinecone, Supabase, etc.). Familiarity with AI agent frameworks (Lang Chain, or equivalent concepts). Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment. Exposure to prompt engineering best practices, like system prompts, chaining, few-shot design. Work Details Hours: 9 A. M. – 5 P. M. MST, Monday to Friday Requires a working level of written and spoken English If you're someone who can look at a messy manual process, see the system hiding inside it, and build something that runs without you, we want to hear from you. Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now! Note: Due to the high number of applicants across roles, responses and processes will take a while.

title: Motion designer
description:
Empresa está contratando Motion designer em rio branco. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

LEIA A DESCRIÇÃO! Para se candidatar, preencha o formulário: Wr B1wdp28 NOSSO JEITO DE SER E FAZER O time da Pay Conductor é feito por pessoas obcecadas por resolver problemas reais de pagamentos: gente que entende que cada décimo de ponto na taxa de aprovação representa milhões na ponta dos nossos clientes. Acreditamos que orquestração não é só tecnologia, é devolver às empresas o controle sobre o seu próprio dinheiro. Construímos uma plataforma AI-driven que conecta adquirentes, gateways e meios de pagamento em uma única camada inteligente, e estamos só começando. Se você quer fazer parte do time que está redefinindo a infraestrutura de pagamentos do Brasil, é aqui. E aí, quer construir o futuro dos pagamentos com a gente? SOBRE A VAGA O time de Marketing da Pay Conductor é responsável por traduzir uma plataforma técnica e robusta em uma marca desejada por empreendedores digitais, varejistas, e-commerces e líderes do mercado financeiro. A sua missão como Motion Designer será transformar conceitos complexos, como roteamento inteligente, taxa de aprovação, antifraude, recuperação de vendas e inteligência de pagamentos, em vídeos, animações e peças visuais que prendem atenção, explicam com clareza e fortalecem a percepção da marca. Buscamos uma pessoa criativa, detalhista e com repertório visual forte. Alguém que entenda que motion não é apenas "fazer elementos se mexerem", mas construir narrativa, ritmo e impacto visual. Você vai trabalhar de perto com Marketing, Conteúdo, Design e fundadores, criando assets para redes sociais, campanhas, materiais comerciais, eventos, lançamentos e apresentações. Mais do que executar briefings, queremos alguém que proponha caminhos visuais, teste formatos e ajude a construir uma marca forte, moderna e memorável. VOCÊ TERÁ ENTRE SUAS RESPONSABILIDADES: Criar vídeos e animações para os canais oficiais da Pay Conductor, como Linked In, Instagram, You Tube, site e novos canais conforme estratégia. Desenvolver motion graphics para posts, carrosséis animados, reels, vídeos curtos, campanhas e materiais institucionais. Transformar roteiros e conceitos técnicos em animações claras, bonitas e fáceis de entender. Animar ícones, gráficos, interfaces, fluxos de pagamento, dashboards, transações e elementos visuais da marca. Apoiar a produção de vídeos para campanhas de mídia paga, eventos, lançamentos e ações comerciais. Criar variações de peças animadas para testes de performance e diferentes formatos de distribuição. Editar vídeos curtos com ritmo, cortes, legendas, trilhas, transições e acabamento profissional. Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com Design e Conteúdo para garantir coesão visual e narrativa da marca. Ajudar a evoluir a linguagem visual da Pay Conductor em movimento, respeitando identidade, paleta, tipografia e estilo da marca. Trazer referências visuais, tendências de motion, formatos de redes sociais e ideias para elevar a qualidade criativa dos conteúdos. VOCÊ AGREGARÁ SE POSSUIR: Portfólio com projetos de motion design, edição de vídeo, animação ou peças em movimento. Domínio de ferramentas como After Effects, Premiere, Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, Cap Cut ou similares. Boa noção de composição visual, ritmo, hierarquia, transição, storytelling e acabamento. Sensibilidade estética para criar peças modernas, limpas e com aparência premium. Capacidade de transformar temas técnicos em narrativas visuais simples e interessantes. Organização para lidar com múltiplas demandas em uma rotina dinâmica de marketing. Repertório ativo de referências visuais, redes sociais, design, tecnologia e cultura digital. Vontade de aprender sobre fintech, pagamentos, e-commerce e inteligência artificial. VOCÊ SE DESTACARÁ SE TIVER: Experiência prévia com marcas B2 B, Saa S, fintech, tecnologia, meios de pagamento ou e-commerce. Experiência com animação de UI, dashboards, fluxos de produto e interfaces digitais. Conhecimento em Lottie, Rive, Cinema 4 D, Blender ou outras ferramentas de animação/3 D. Experiência criando vídeos para campanhas de performance, anúncios e testes de criativos. Noções de design gráfico, direção de arte e criação de conceitos visuais. Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA aplicadas à criação, edição, storyboard ou geração de assets. Repertório de marcas com identidade visual forte, linguagem tecnológica e comunicação diferenciada. O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:Esperamos uma pessoa com olhar apurado, autonomia criativa e vontade real de construir. Alguém que consiga pegar um tema complexo e transformar em uma animação clara. Que saiba equilibrar estética com comunicação. Que entenda quando uma peça precisa ser mais institucional, mais comercial, mais educativa ou mais social-first. Na Pay Conductor, você terá espaço para propor, testar e evoluir a linguagem visual de uma marca que está entrando em uma categoria nova e estratégica para o mercado brasileiro. Para se candidatar, preencha o formulário: Wr B1wdp28

title: Servicenow application portfolio management (apm) & data quality engineer - contractor in usd
description:
Nova oportunidade para Servicenow application portfolio management (apm) & data quality engineer - contractor in usd em palmas. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a Service Now Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in Service Now (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress. EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required. Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English. Tasks and responsibilities: Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within Service Now, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency; Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders; Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications; Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging Service Now portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps; Maintain a centralized log or aligned Service Now records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization; Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots; Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials; Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices; Profile: Master's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline; +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology; +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams; Hands-on experience with Service Now, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting; Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize); Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights; Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making; Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates; Previous experience delivering similar Service Now APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred; Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail; AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks; Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders; Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes; Working knowledge of Service Now data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices; Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including: TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification; Service Now Certified System Administrator (CSA); Service Now Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant Service Now implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB; Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including Service Now EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus; Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage; Fluent in English;

title: Client services assistant
description:
Confira a vaga para Client services assistant em manaus. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Client Services Assistant Remote, Latin America Velocity Work helps law firm owners build firms that are profitable, organized, accountable, and not dependent on the owner holding everything together. We're hiring a Client Services Assistant to become a true backbone for our team. This is not a "wait for instructions" role. It's for someone who sees loose ends, tracks the moving pieces, asks smart questions, and makes the system better without needing someone to hover. You'll support current clients, client data, retreat prep, onboarding, internal systems, pipeline tracking, and podcast scheduling. The work is detailed, important, and very real. If you like being the person who knows where things stand, what's missing, and what needs to happen next, this may be a great fit. What You'll Own ----------- Client Services Operations This is the center of the role. You'll help keep current client work moving cleanly: data workflows, dashboards, retreat materials, onboarding, Hub Spot notes, scheduling details, internal reports, recordings, client folders, and recurring team systems. You'll also help catch what's slipping before it becomes a problem: missing data, unclear ownership, stalled tasks, unlogged client context, messy files, late follow-ups, or anything that makes Client Services feel less prepared. The goal is simple: current clients feel cared for, Client Services feels supported, and the team trusts that the operational details are handled. Pipeline + Relationship Tracking You'll help us track important non-client relationships: incoming leads, meetings, deals, contracts, key dates, next steps, and handoffs. You won't be the salesperson or the primary external email owner. You'll keep the system accurate so the right person can follow through well and Client Services can provide a high-touch experience before someone becomes a client. Podcast Scheduling + Production Coordination You'll help keep our podcast schedule realistic and ahead of the calendar. That means protecting planning time, suggesting recording days that match the production schedule, tracking key dates, and flagging when we need to record multiple episodes ahead because the business calendar is getting full. You won't own content, writing, editing, or creative direction. This is schedule, process, and timeline management. This Role Is a Fit If You: • Notice gaps and communicate them early • Take ownership without needing to be chased • Track details carefully and follow through completely • Ask smart questions, then remember the answer • Can support a busy team without adding noise • Stay calm when priorities shift • Take pride in being reliable, thorough, and useful This Role Is Not a Fit If You: • Need detailed instructions for every task • Wait to be told what to do next • See problems but don't speak up • Think "done" means "mostly handled" • Struggle when a process is not perfectly documented Requirements • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills • Clear written and verbal English • High ownership and follow-through • Strong attention to detail • Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities • Experience with calendars, spreadsheets, CRMs, project management tools, and modern Saa S systems • Fast, stable internet connection • Professional presence on video Tools may include Click Up, Hub Spot, Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, Loom, Fireflies, reporting dashboards, spreadsheets, and podcast scheduling tools. Work Setup Remote, Latin America preferred Contractor, 40 hours/week with meaningful overlap with U. S. business hours Compensation: $1000/mo USD (you will invoce your hours) How to Apply We care about experience, but we care more about ownership, judgment, communication, and follow-through. You'll submit: • Your resume • A short video introducing yourself and telling us why this role speaks to you • Anything else that helps us understand how you think and work We will follow up with a shortlist of prospects and request a Sample Project submission that will demonstrate aspects of the work you'll be doing, and we will compensate you for the time that takes. We're looking for someone who wants to become a real operational partner to the team, not just complete assigned tasks. If you're the kind of person who sees the gap, owns the follow-through, and makes the whole team feel more organized, we want to meet you.

title: Global ta manager (contractor role)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Global ta manager (contractor role) em manaus. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Location: Remote (Based in Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, or Brazil) Contract Duration: 6 months (with potential for extension/long-term partnership) Compensation: Base Rate + Performance-Based Placement Bonus (Earn extra for every successful hire!) Role Overview We are stripping away the corporate red tape. This role is built for one thing and one thing only: Pure, High-Velocity Recruitment Delivery. As a Global TA Manager, you will focus entirely on the frontlines of our international experienced hiring tracks (spanning R& D, Product, and Growth) across the U. S., Europe, LATAM, and Asia. You will be the bridging force between global talent and our HQ team. If you are an independent recruiter who prides yourself on speed, market-mapping accuracy, and closing deals, this is your playground. What You Will Do- High-Volume Sourcing & Delivery: Own the end-to-end sourcing and pipeline management for mid-to-senior global roles. You will hunt via Linked In, regional job boards, Git Hub, and cold-outreach to keep our pipelines buzzing. HQ & Candidate Facilitation: Screen global talent, pitch our vision, and seamlessly manage candidates through the interview process, acting as the primary point of contact. Data & Pipeline Transparency: Keep candidate trackers clean and updated, ensuring our global talent pipelines are accurate and moving fast. The DNA We Are Looking For- The Baseline (Hard Skills): Bilingual Mastery (English & Chinese): Both English and Mandarin Chinese must be your fluent working languages. You can interview global talent in flawless English and align instantly with our HQ hiring managers in Chinese. Proven Recruitment Engine: 2-4+ years of recruiting experience in tech, internet, or global expansion enterprises. A proven track record of delivering cross-border talent is a massive plus. Geographic Flexibility: Based in Indonesia, Vietnam, or the U. S., with deep roots in local talent networks but a completely global mindset. Core Traits (Soft Skills): The \"Bias for Action\" Delivery Machine: You are fiercely result-oriented, self-driven, and hyper-focused on closing roles. You think on your feet and get things done without waiting for instructions. Insatiable Curiosity & No Guardrails: You don't get trapped by fixed processes. You are eager to experiment with new sourcing hacks, leverage AI tools, and test bold outreach strategies to find that needle in a haystack. What You Will Get & The Challenges You Will Face What You Will Get: Uncapped Earning Potential: On top of your base rate, we offer a highly competitive, milestone-based placement bonus layout. The faster and more effectively you deliver, the more you earn. The Global Flex-Work Playbook: Get hands-on, practical experience inside a highly progressive global flexible-staffing ecosystem. You'll see exactly how a top-tier global tech brand runs an agile, remote talent network. A Trusted Extension of the Crew: No micromanagement. You enjoy the ultimate flexibility of a remote setup while having a world-class global TA team supporting you from behind. The Challenges You Will Face: 100% Remote Coordination: Working across time zones requires you to be hyper-proactive. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule. Embracing Ambiguity: Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts. If you are a bilingual recruitment hustler who is ready to deliver global talent and write your own paycheck via performance bonuses, let's talk. Apply now and let's make a global impact together!

title: Ai automation specialist
description:
Empresa está contratando Ai automation specialist em boa vista. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Hey, Dingus! Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, systems-minded AI Automation Specialist who can build, connect, and scale intelligent workflows that actually work in production. About Us Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an "unlimited get-shit-done" subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between. Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading. What You'll Do Build and maintain automated workflows using N8 N, connecting APIs, webhooks, and data sources into seamless pipelines. Integrate and prompt Claude (Anthropic) and other LLMs into production systems, not just experiments. Manage and automate data operations in Airtable, including scripted fields, automations, and structured data pipelines. Design AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort across client delivery, internal ops, and content production. Troubleshoot broken pipelines, handle edge cases, and document systems so they don't live only in your head. Collaborate with strategy and delivery teams to identify automation opportunities and scope builds accurately. Stay current on the AI tooling landscape, you should know what's worth using before we ask. Own and iterate on AI agent logic and system prompts, understanding why a workflow behaves the way it does and improving it over time. Build net-new internal AI tools as the business identifies opportunities, not just maintain what exists. What You Bring 2+ years of hands-on experience building automated workflows (N8 N, , or Zapier, N8 N strongly preferred). Real experience integrating LLMs via API (Claude, GPT, or equivalent) into production pipelines with structured outputs. Proficiency in Airtable as a data layer, scripting, automations, relational structures. Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and webhook-based integrations. Basic scripting ability in Python or Java Script, enough to write and debug function nodes without hand-holding. A working understanding of HTML and CSS is imperative, you need to be able to read, interpret, and make sense of front-end structure when workflows touch web-based outputs. A systems thinker mindset: you design the whole loop, not just the happy path. Ability to work independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment. Comfort with versioning and testing AI outputs, you notice when a prompt change breaks something and know how to fix it. Bonus Points Experience with vector databases or basic RAG pipelines (Pinecone, Supabase, etc.). Familiarity with AI agent frameworks (Lang Chain, or equivalent concepts). Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment. Exposure to prompt engineering best practices, like system prompts, chaining, few-shot design. Work Details Hours: 9 A. M. – 5 P. M. MST, Monday to Friday Requires a working level of written and spoken English If you're someone who can look at a messy manual process, see the system hiding inside it, and build something that runs without you, we want to hear from you. Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now! Note: Due to the high number of applicants across roles, responses and processes will take a while.

title: Senior java developer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior java developer em manaus. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

A VMetrix é uma plataforma Saa S que atende instituições financeiras na América Latina. Processamos fluxos transacionais complexos, pipelines de dados de alto volume e integrações em tempo real — tudo construído sobre uma stack Java/Spring Boot + Oracle implantada na Oracle Cloud. Buscamos desenvolvedores Java sólidos que escrevam código excelente, pensem em sistemas e adotem o desenvolvimento assistido por IA como parte central do seu fluxo de trabalho. Propósito do Cargo Como Senior Java Developer, você vai construir e manter serviços backend e módulos de plataforma que suportam operações críticas de negócio. Você não precisa de experiência prévia no domínio financeiro — nós ensinamos. O que precisamos é de um desenvolvedor que escreva Java limpo e performante, domine padrões de design, entenda sistemas distribuídos e use ferramentas como Claude Code para se mover rápido sem sacrificar qualidade. Responsabilidades Principais: Desenvolvimento Backend Projetar, construir e manter serviços backend em Java 8+/Spring Boot: APIs REST, jobs de processamento batch, pipelines de transformação de dados e camadas de integração. Escrever código limpo, bem testado e pronto para produção, aplicando princípios SOLID, padrões de design (Strategy, Factory, Observer, Builder, Template Method, entre outros) e as diretrizes arquiteturais da equipe. Ser dono de features end-to-end: desde o design técnico até a implementação, testes, code review e deploy em produção. Otimizar o desempenho de aplicações: identificar e resolver gargalos em queries, chamadas a serviços, uso de memória e throughput. Aplicar corretamente padrões de concorrência e gerenciamento de threads em Java para operações paralelas e assíncronas. Design e Arquitetura Participar de decisões de design de software: seleção de padrões, definição de contratos entre componentes, separação de responsabilidades e modelagem de domínios. Aplicar princípios de design orientado a objetos (encapsulamento, herança, composição, polimorfismo) e design por contrato na construção de módulos. Contribuir para o design de arquiteturas limpas: separação de camadas (controller, service, repository), injeção de dependências, inversão de controle e baixo acoplamento entre módulos. Avaliar trade-offs técnicos entre diferentes abordagens de design, documentando decisões e suas justificativas. Banco de Dados e Integrações Trabalhar com Oracle Database: escrever e otimizar consultas SQL, stored procedures e packages PL/SQL para operações intensivas em dados. Construir e manter integrações com sistemas externos via APIs REST, cobrindo ingestão, transformação e sincronização de dados. Projetar padrões de acesso a dados eficientes usando JPA/Hibernate ou JDBC, com atenção a gerenciamento de conexões, cache de entidades e limites transacionais. Implementar estratégias de resiliência em integrações: retentativas, circuit breakers, timeouts e tratamento gracioso de falhas. Infraestrutura e Deploy Implantar e gerenciar aplicações em Kubernetes (OKE) com contêineres Docker e servidor de aplicações Web Logic. Trabalhar com pipelines CI/CD (Git Lab CI ou similar) para fluxos automatizados de build, teste e deployment. Diagnosticar problemas em produção: analisar logs, métricas de aplicação e comportamento do sistema para resolver incidentes. Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA Usar Claude Code como ferramenta principal de desenvolvimento: geração de código, refatoração, debugging, escrita de testes e exploração de codebases desconhecidos. Escrever e manter documentação técnica em Markdown que sirva como contexto de alta qualidade tanto para ferramentas de IA quanto para a equipe. Aplicar habilidades de engenharia de prompts: decompor problemas complexos em prompts claros e acionáveis, avaliando criticamente as saídas geradas por IA. Contribuir para as práticas de desenvolvimento com IA da equipe: compartilhar padrões eficazes, identificar limitações e ajudar a estabelecer melhores práticas. Colaboração e Crescimento Participar de revisões de código com feedback construtivo e rigoroso, focado em corretude, legibilidade, padrões e manutenibilidade. Mentorar desenvolvedores junior através de pair programming, discussões de design e transferência de conhecimento. Contribuir para discussões técnicas sobre arquitetura, ferramentas e melhorias de processos. Requisitos Obrigatórios: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas. 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento Java. Domínio sólido de Java 8+ (streams, lambdas, concorrência, collections, Optional, API de data/hora) e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, segurança, Spring Data, testes). Conhecimento sólido de padrões de design Go F (criacionais, estruturais, comportamentais) e capacidade de aplicá-los corretamente conforme o contexto do problema. Domínio dos princípios SOLID, DRY, KISS e YAGNI na prática diária de desenvolvimento. Experiência com design orientado a objetos: modelagem de domínios, composição vs herança, encapsulamento, tratamento de exceções e design de APIs internas claras. Habilidades sólidas em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais: otimização de queries, estratégias de indexação, joins complexos, gerenciamento transacional. Experiência com Oracle é um diferencial forte. Experiência com estratégias de testes: testes unitários (JUnit, Mockito), testes de integração, test doubles e TDD ou BDD como prática habitual. Experiência com deploys em contêineres: Docker, Kubernetes (qualquer distribuição), pipelines CI/CD. Familiaridade com fluxos Git (Git Flow ou trunk-based), Postman/Open API para desenvolvimento de APIs. Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA — especialmente Claude Code. Esperamos que você use IA diariamente como multiplicador de produtividade, não como muleta. Comunicação escrita sólida: capacidade de produzir specs técnicos claros, documentos de design e descrições de PR. Requisitos Desejáveis: Experiência com Oracle PL/SQL: stored procedures, pipelined functions, performance tuning. Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura: caching (Caffeine/Redis), arquitetura event-driven, design metadata-driven, CQRS. Experiência com arquiteturas de microsserviços ou modular monolith: estratégias de comunicação entre serviços, gerenciamento de transações distribuídas, contract testing. Familiaridade com Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture ou Domain-Driven Design (DDD). Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade: Grafana, Prometheus, métricas de aplicação, agregação de logs. Familiaridade com servidor de aplicações Web Logic ou runtimes Java empresariais similares. Experiência trabalhando em plataformas Saa S ou sistemas multi-tenant. Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações técnicas equivalentes. O Que Valorizamos: Qualidade acima de velocidade: preferimos entregar código limpo e bem testado um dia depois do que debugar um desastre por uma semana. Fluência com IA: você vê Claude Code e ferramentas similares como partes essenciais do seu toolkit, não como novidades. Sabe quando confiar no output e quando questioná-lo. Critério de design: você não aplica padrões por inércia — sabe quando um Strategy simplifica e quando um if-else é suficiente. Prioriza clareza acima de cleverness. Pensamento sistêmico: considera os efeitos downstream das suas decisões de design em desempenho, manutenibilidade e velocidade da equipe. Ownership: leva suas features do design até produção e se importa com como seu código se comporta no mundo real. Curiosidade: se mantém atualizado com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento, e tem interesse genuíno em evoluir no seu ofício. Comunicação clara: escreve documentação que seus colegas de equipe (e as ferramentas de IA) realmente conseguem usar. Processo de Candidatura: Candidatura: Candidate-se diretamente pelo Linked In. Teste técnico: Os candidatos selecionados receberão uma avaliação técnica online. Esta etapa é obrigatória e parte fundamental do processo. Entrevista com Líder e RH: Uma conversa com a equipe para te conhecer melhor e aprofundar sua experiência. Decisão: Informaremos o resultado com feedback, independentemente de você avançar ou não. Por que trabalhar na VMetrix Na VMetrix, não buscamos "fazer mais barulho", mas sim construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva. Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional. Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relações de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, a VMetrix é o lugar.

title: Direct-response ad video editor
description:
Confira a vaga para Direct-response ad video editor em rio branco. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

We're looking for a direct response video editor who can produce 1-3 performance ads per day — consistently, quickly, and without hand-holding. You'll receive reference ads, raw footage, AI-generated visuals, voiceover audio, product photography, UGC clips, and creative briefs. Your job is to turn those inputs into scroll-stopping Meta ads that look native to the feed, follow direct response principles, and are ready to launch same-day. Some days you'll get a detailed brief with every asset handed to you. Other days you'll get a reference ad and a direction — and you'll need to reverse-engineer the structure, build a visual concept, and deliver a finished ad using your own creative instincts. This is not a 9-to-5 editing job. This is a performance marketing role that happens to live inside an editing timeline. What You'll Be Doing Editing 1-3 short-form video ads per day (15-60 seconds) for Meta placements Working with a mix of UGC footage, AI-generated imagery, 3 D medical-style animations, product photography, voiceover tracks, and b-roll Receiving reference ads and reverse-engineering their pacing, structure, visual rhythm, and caption systems to build Velor Health versions Building ads from creative briefs that include scripts, shot lists, visual direction, and caption specs Originating new ad concepts when given only a direction or angle — proposing visual treatments, caption styles, and pacing without being told exactly what to do Implementing caption systems with color-coded text (white/red/blue pill captions, green keyword highlights, auto-generated Tik Tok-style captions) depending on the ad format Cutting multiple versions of the same ad (hook variants, length variants, aspect ratio variants) for A/B testing Maintaining a fast turnaround — most ads should go from brief to finished export within 2-4 hours Organizing and managing a growing library of raw assets, finished ads, and creative templates What You Need Proven experience editing direct response or performance marketing video ads (not brand content, not music videos, not wedding films — direct response ads that ran on Meta or Tik Tok with measurable results) Fluency in Cap Cut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects — whichever you're fastest in Strong understanding of Meta ad formats — you know what a native feed ad looks like versus a produced commercial, and you default to native Ability to match reference ad pacing intuitively — if we send you a competitor ad, you can deconstruct its cut timing, caption rhythm, and visual structure without being taught Comfort working with AI-generated imagery and integrating it seamlessly into live footage and product photography Experience with caption styling — you've built caption systems before (color-coded, keyword-highlighted, timed to VO) and you understand that captions are a conversion tool, not an accessibility afterthought A sharp eye for thumbnail-level scroll-stopping — you understand that the first frame of a video ad is a static image in the feed and you treat it accordingly Ability to self-manage, meet daily output targets, and communicate proactively when something is unclear or delayed Reliable internet connection and availability during US business hours (ET or CT preferred but flexible for the right person) Bonus (Not Required) Experience editing ads in the health, wellness, fitness, or DTC supplement space Familiarity with the \"ugly ad\" aesthetic — ads intentionally designed to look like organic UGC rather than polished production Experience with motion graphics or basic After Effects animation (for text overlays, simple transitions, or kinetic typography) Understanding of direct response copywriting principles (you know why a hook matters, why the product should appear early, why the CTA needs to sound like a peer recommendation) What You Don't Need A film degree A fancy reel of cinematic work Experience at a big agency Color grading expertise We care about speed, instinct, and output quality at volume. If your best work is a single beautifully-graded 3-minute brand film, this isn't the right fit. If your best work is 47 Meta ads you cut last month that all drove profitable ROAS, we want to talk to you. Compensation Competitive rate based on experience. This is a contract role with potential to grow into a long-term position as the brand scales. We value speed and consistency — editors who hit daily output targets reliably will have no shortage of work. How To Apply There will be a paid test before any hire is made. Here's how it works: Apply with your portfolio. Send 3-5 examples of direct response video ads you've edited that actually ran on Meta or Tik Tok. Tell us the niche, the objective, and the result if you have it. We don't need a sizzle reel — we need proof you've done this before. If your portfolio fits, we'll send you a paid test project. You'll receive a reference ad, a script, raw assets (footage, images, voiceover), and a creative brief. You'll have 24 hours to deliver a finished ad. This test is paid regardless of whether you're hired. We evaluate the test on four criteria: Did you match the pacing and structure of the reference? Did the first frame stop the scroll? Did the captions and visual rhythm support the VO? Did you deliver on time? If the test passes, you start with a one-week trial at 1 ad per day. If that week goes well, we scale to full output. We're not looking for perfection. We're looking for someone who ships fast, learns from references quickly, and gets better with every ad they cut. To apply, send your portfolio and a brief note about your direct response editing experience to (your email) with the subject line \"DR Editor — (Your Name).\"

title: Senior java developer
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior java developer em palmas. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

A VMetrix é uma plataforma Saa S que atende instituições financeiras na América Latina. Processamos fluxos transacionais complexos, pipelines de dados de alto volume e integrações em tempo real — tudo construído sobre uma stack Java/Spring Boot + Oracle implantada na Oracle Cloud. Buscamos desenvolvedores Java sólidos que escrevam código excelente, pensem em sistemas e adotem o desenvolvimento assistido por IA como parte central do seu fluxo de trabalho. Propósito do Cargo Como Senior Java Developer, você vai construir e manter serviços backend e módulos de plataforma que suportam operações críticas de negócio. Você não precisa de experiência prévia no domínio financeiro — nós ensinamos. O que precisamos é de um desenvolvedor que escreva Java limpo e performante, domine padrões de design, entenda sistemas distribuídos e use ferramentas como Claude Code para se mover rápido sem sacrificar qualidade. Responsabilidades Principais: Desenvolvimento Backend Projetar, construir e manter serviços backend em Java 8+/Spring Boot: APIs REST, jobs de processamento batch, pipelines de transformação de dados e camadas de integração. Escrever código limpo, bem testado e pronto para produção, aplicando princípios SOLID, padrões de design (Strategy, Factory, Observer, Builder, Template Method, entre outros) e as diretrizes arquiteturais da equipe. Ser dono de features end-to-end: desde o design técnico até a implementação, testes, code review e deploy em produção. Otimizar o desempenho de aplicações: identificar e resolver gargalos em queries, chamadas a serviços, uso de memória e throughput. Aplicar corretamente padrões de concorrência e gerenciamento de threads em Java para operações paralelas e assíncronas. Design e Arquitetura Participar de decisões de design de software: seleção de padrões, definição de contratos entre componentes, separação de responsabilidades e modelagem de domínios. Aplicar princípios de design orientado a objetos (encapsulamento, herança, composição, polimorfismo) e design por contrato na construção de módulos. Contribuir para o design de arquiteturas limpas: separação de camadas (controller, service, repository), injeção de dependências, inversão de controle e baixo acoplamento entre módulos. Avaliar trade-offs técnicos entre diferentes abordagens de design, documentando decisões e suas justificativas. Banco de Dados e Integrações Trabalhar com Oracle Database: escrever e otimizar consultas SQL, stored procedures e packages PL/SQL para operações intensivas em dados. Construir e manter integrações com sistemas externos via APIs REST, cobrindo ingestão, transformação e sincronização de dados. Projetar padrões de acesso a dados eficientes usando JPA/Hibernate ou JDBC, com atenção a gerenciamento de conexões, cache de entidades e limites transacionais. Implementar estratégias de resiliência em integrações: retentativas, circuit breakers, timeouts e tratamento gracioso de falhas. Infraestrutura e Deploy Implantar e gerenciar aplicações em Kubernetes (OKE) com contêineres Docker e servidor de aplicações Web Logic. Trabalhar com pipelines CI/CD (Git Lab CI ou similar) para fluxos automatizados de build, teste e deployment. Diagnosticar problemas em produção: analisar logs, métricas de aplicação e comportamento do sistema para resolver incidentes. Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA Usar Claude Code como ferramenta principal de desenvolvimento: geração de código, refatoração, debugging, escrita de testes e exploração de codebases desconhecidos. Escrever e manter documentação técnica em Markdown que sirva como contexto de alta qualidade tanto para ferramentas de IA quanto para a equipe. Aplicar habilidades de engenharia de prompts: decompor problemas complexos em prompts claros e acionáveis, avaliando criticamente as saídas geradas por IA. Contribuir para as práticas de desenvolvimento com IA da equipe: compartilhar padrões eficazes, identificar limitações e ajudar a estabelecer melhores práticas. Colaboração e Crescimento Participar de revisões de código com feedback construtivo e rigoroso, focado em corretude, legibilidade, padrões e manutenibilidade. Mentorar desenvolvedores junior através de pair programming, discussões de design e transferência de conhecimento. Contribuir para discussões técnicas sobre arquitetura, ferramentas e melhorias de processos. Requisitos Obrigatórios: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas. 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento Java. Domínio sólido de Java 8+ (streams, lambdas, concorrência, collections, Optional, API de data/hora) e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, segurança, Spring Data, testes). Conhecimento sólido de padrões de design Go F (criacionais, estruturais, comportamentais) e capacidade de aplicá-los corretamente conforme o contexto do problema. Domínio dos princípios SOLID, DRY, KISS e YAGNI na prática diária de desenvolvimento. Experiência com design orientado a objetos: modelagem de domínios, composição vs herança, encapsulamento, tratamento de exceções e design de APIs internas claras. Habilidades sólidas em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais: otimização de queries, estratégias de indexação, joins complexos, gerenciamento transacional. Experiência com Oracle é um diferencial forte. Experiência com estratégias de testes: testes unitários (JUnit, Mockito), testes de integração, test doubles e TDD ou BDD como prática habitual. Experiência com deploys em contêineres: Docker, Kubernetes (qualquer distribuição), pipelines CI/CD. Familiaridade com fluxos Git (Git Flow ou trunk-based), Postman/Open API para desenvolvimento de APIs. Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA — especialmente Claude Code. Esperamos que você use IA diariamente como multiplicador de produtividade, não como muleta. Comunicação escrita sólida: capacidade de produzir specs técnicos claros, documentos de design e descrições de PR. Requisitos Desejáveis: Experiência com Oracle PL/SQL: stored procedures, pipelined functions, performance tuning. Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura: caching (Caffeine/Redis), arquitetura event-driven, design metadata-driven, CQRS. Experiência com arquiteturas de microsserviços ou modular monolith: estratégias de comunicação entre serviços, gerenciamento de transações distribuídas, contract testing. Familiaridade com Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture ou Domain-Driven Design (DDD). Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade: Grafana, Prometheus, métricas de aplicação, agregação de logs. Familiaridade com servidor de aplicações Web Logic ou runtimes Java empresariais similares. Experiência trabalhando em plataformas Saa S ou sistemas multi-tenant. Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações técnicas equivalentes. O Que Valorizamos: Qualidade acima de velocidade: preferimos entregar código limpo e bem testado um dia depois do que debugar um desastre por uma semana. Fluência com IA: você vê Claude Code e ferramentas similares como partes essenciais do seu toolkit, não como novidades. Sabe quando confiar no output e quando questioná-lo. Critério de design: você não aplica padrões por inércia — sabe quando um Strategy simplifica e quando um if-else é suficiente. Prioriza clareza acima de cleverness. Pensamento sistêmico: considera os efeitos downstream das suas decisões de design em desempenho, manutenibilidade e velocidade da equipe. Ownership: leva suas features do design até produção e se importa com como seu código se comporta no mundo real. Curiosidade: se mantém atualizado com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento, e tem interesse genuíno em evoluir no seu ofício. Comunicação clara: escreve documentação que seus colegas de equipe (e as ferramentas de IA) realmente conseguem usar. Processo de Candidatura: Candidatura: Candidate-se diretamente pelo Linked In. Teste técnico: Os candidatos selecionados receberão uma avaliação técnica online. Esta etapa é obrigatória e parte fundamental do processo. Entrevista com Líder e RH: Uma conversa com a equipe para te conhecer melhor e aprofundar sua experiência. Decisão: Informaremos o resultado com feedback, independentemente de você avançar ou não. Por que trabalhar na VMetrix Na VMetrix, não buscamos "fazer mais barulho", mas sim construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva. Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional. Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relações de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, a VMetrix é o lugar.

title: Global ta manager (contractor role)
description:

Location: Remote (Based in Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, or Brazil) Contract Duration: 6 months (with potential for extension/long-term partnership) Compensation: Base Rate + Performance-Based Placement Bonus (Earn extra for every successful hire!) Role Overview We are stripping away the corporate red tape. This role is built for one thing and one thing only: Pure, High-Velocity Recruitment Delivery. As a Global TA Manager, you will focus entirely on the frontlines of our international experienced hiring tracks (spanning R& D, Product, and Growth) across the U. S., Europe, LATAM, and Asia. You will be the bridging force between global talent and our HQ team. If you are an independent recruiter who prides yourself on speed, market-mapping accuracy, and closing deals, this is your playground. What You Will Do- High-Volume Sourcing & Delivery: Own the end-to-end sourcing and pipeline management for mid-to-senior global roles. You will hunt via Linked In, regional job boards, Git Hub, and cold-outreach to keep our pipelines buzzing. HQ & Candidate Facilitation: Screen global talent, pitch our vision, and seamlessly manage candidates through the interview process, acting as the primary point of contact. Company Description: Million Logics is a trusted Oracle Partner and global leader in IT solutions, with operations in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. With a team of 85+ AI/ML experts, we deliver tailored solutions that foster digital transformation and operational excellence. We are committed to client success. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and You Tube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions such as Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness. Offer Details: Duration of Contract: 6 months Pay: $1500 per month (net/take-home) Mode of work: Fully Remote Number of Positions: 20 Must have fluency in Portgutal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese ) Skills: Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred. BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field). Key Qualifications: Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portgutal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese ) with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project. Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (Sx S) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and over-narrating. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection. Description: In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied. Analysing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"over-narrating\". Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (Sx S) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history. Education & Experience: BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field). Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred. Additional Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type: Contractor Engagement Length: 6 months

title: Client services assistant
description:
Confira a vaga para Client services assistant em boa vista. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Client Services Assistant Remote, Latin America Velocity Work helps law firm owners build firms that are profitable, organized, accountable, and not dependent on the owner holding everything together. We're hiring a Client Services Assistant to become a true backbone for our team. This is not a "wait for instructions" role. It's for someone who sees loose ends, tracks the moving pieces, asks smart questions, and makes the system better without needing someone to hover. You'll support current clients, client data, retreat prep, onboarding, internal systems, pipeline tracking, and podcast scheduling. The work is detailed, important, and very real. If you like being the person who knows where things stand, what's missing, and what needs to happen next, this may be a great fit. What You'll Own ----------- Client Services Operations This is the center of the role. You'll help keep current client work moving cleanly: data workflows, dashboards, retreat materials, onboarding, Hub Spot notes, scheduling details, internal reports, recordings, client folders, and recurring team systems. You'll also help catch what's slipping before it becomes a problem: missing data, unclear ownership, stalled tasks, unlogged client context, messy files, late follow-ups, or anything that makes Client Services feel less prepared. The goal is simple: current clients feel cared for, Client Services feels supported, and the team trusts that the operational details are handled. Pipeline + Relationship Tracking You'll help us track important non-client relationships: incoming leads, meetings, deals, contracts, key dates, next steps, and handoffs. You won't be the salesperson or the primary external email owner. You'll keep the system accurate so the right person can follow through well and Client Services can provide a high-touch experience before someone becomes a client. Podcast Scheduling + Production Coordination You'll help keep our podcast schedule realistic and ahead of the calendar. That means protecting planning time, suggesting recording days that match the production schedule, tracking key dates, and flagging when we need to record multiple episodes ahead because the business calendar is getting full. You won't own content, writing, editing, or creative direction. This is schedule, process, and timeline management. This Role Is a Fit If You: • Notice gaps and communicate them early • Take ownership without needing to be chased • Track details carefully and follow through completely • Ask smart questions, then remember the answer • Can support a busy team without adding noise • Stay calm when priorities shift • Take pride in being reliable, thorough, and useful This Role Is Not a Fit If You: • Need detailed instructions for every task • Wait to be told what to do next • See problems but don't speak up • Think "done" means "mostly handled" • Struggle when a process is not perfectly documented Requirements • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills • Clear written and verbal English • High ownership and follow-through • Strong attention to detail • Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities • Experience with calendars, spreadsheets, CRMs, project management tools, and modern Saa S systems • Fast, stable internet connection • Professional presence on video Tools may include Click Up, Hub Spot, Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, Loom, Fireflies, reporting dashboards, spreadsheets, and podcast scheduling tools. Work Setup Remote, Latin America preferred Contractor, 40 hours/week with meaningful overlap with U. S. business hours Compensation: $1000/mo USD (you will invoce your hours) How to Apply We care about experience, but we care more about ownership, judgment, communication, and follow-through. You'll submit: • Your resume • A short video introducing yourself and telling us why this role speaks to you • Anything else that helps us understand how you think and work We will follow up with a shortlist of prospects and request a Sample Project submission that will demonstrate aspects of the work you'll be doing, and we will compensate you for the time that takes. We're looking for someone who wants to become a real operational partner to the team, not just complete assigned tasks. If you're the kind of person who sees the gap, owns the follow-through, and makes the whole team feel more organized, we want to meet you.

title: Direct-response ad video editor
description:
Confira a vaga para Direct-response ad video editor em manaus. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

We're looking for a direct response video editor who can produce 1-3 performance ads per day — consistently, quickly, and without hand-holding. You'll receive reference ads, raw footage, AI-generated visuals, voiceover audio, product photography, UGC clips, and creative briefs. Your job is to turn those inputs into scroll-stopping Meta ads that look native to the feed, follow direct response principles, and are ready to launch same-day. Some days you'll get a detailed brief with every asset handed to you. Other days you'll get a reference ad and a direction — and you'll need to reverse-engineer the structure, build a visual concept, and deliver a finished ad using your own creative instincts. This is not a 9-to-5 editing job. This is a performance marketing role that happens to live inside an editing timeline. What You'll Be Doing Editing 1-3 short-form video ads per day (15-60 seconds) for Meta placements Working with a mix of UGC footage, AI-generated imagery, 3 D medical-style animations, product photography, voiceover tracks, and b-roll Receiving reference ads and reverse-engineering their pacing, structure, visual rhythm, and caption systems to build Velor Health versions Building ads from creative briefs that include scripts, shot lists, visual direction, and caption specs Originating new ad concepts when given only a direction or angle — proposing visual treatments, caption styles, and pacing without being told exactly what to do Implementing caption systems with color-coded text (white/red/blue pill captions, green keyword highlights, auto-generated Tik Tok-style captions) depending on the ad format Cutting multiple versions of the same ad (hook variants, length variants, aspect ratio variants) for A/B testing Maintaining a fast turnaround — most ads should go from brief to finished export within 2-4 hours Organizing and managing a growing library of raw assets, finished ads, and creative templates What You Need Proven experience editing direct response or performance marketing video ads (not brand content, not music videos, not wedding films — direct response ads that ran on Meta or Tik Tok with measurable results) Fluency in Cap Cut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects — whichever you're fastest in Strong understanding of Meta ad formats — you know what a native feed ad looks like versus a produced commercial, and you default to native Ability to match reference ad pacing intuitively — if we send you a competitor ad, you can deconstruct its cut timing, caption rhythm, and visual structure without being taught Comfort working with AI-generated imagery and integrating it seamlessly into live footage and product photography Experience with caption styling — you've built caption systems before (color-coded, keyword-highlighted, timed to VO) and you understand that captions are a conversion tool, not an accessibility afterthought A sharp eye for thumbnail-level scroll-stopping — you understand that the first frame of a video ad is a static image in the feed and you treat it accordingly Ability to self-manage, meet daily output targets, and communicate proactively when something is unclear or delayed Reliable internet connection and availability during US business hours (ET or CT preferred but flexible for the right person) Bonus (Not Required) Experience editing ads in the health, wellness, fitness, or DTC supplement space Familiarity with the \"ugly ad\" aesthetic — ads intentionally designed to look like organic UGC rather than polished production Experience with motion graphics or basic After Effects animation (for text overlays, simple transitions, or kinetic typography) Understanding of direct response copywriting principles (you know why a hook matters, why the product should appear early, why the CTA needs to sound like a peer recommendation) What You Don't Need A film degree A fancy reel of cinematic work Experience at a big agency Color grading expertise We care about speed, instinct, and output quality at volume. If your best work is a single beautifully-graded 3-minute brand film, this isn't the right fit. If your best work is 47 Meta ads you cut last month that all drove profitable ROAS, we want to talk to you. Compensation Competitive rate based on experience. This is a contract role with potential to grow into a long-term position as the brand scales. We value speed and consistency — editors who hit daily output targets reliably will have no shortage of work. How To Apply There will be a paid test before any hire is made. Here's how it works: Apply with your portfolio. Send 3-5 examples of direct response video ads you've edited that actually ran on Meta or Tik Tok. Tell us the niche, the objective, and the result if you have it. We don't need a sizzle reel — we need proof you've done this before. If your portfolio fits, we'll send you a paid test project. You'll receive a reference ad, a script, raw assets (footage, images, voiceover), and a creative brief. You'll have 24 hours to deliver a finished ad. This test is paid regardless of whether you're hired. We evaluate the test on four criteria: Did you match the pacing and structure of the reference? Did the first frame stop the scroll? Did the captions and visual rhythm support the VO? Did you deliver on time? If the test passes, you start with a one-week trial at 1 ad per day. If that week goes well, we scale to full output. We're not looking for perfection. We're looking for someone who ships fast, learns from references quickly, and gets better with every ad they cut. To apply, send your portfolio and a brief note about your direct response editing experience to (your email) with the subject line \"DR Editor — (Your Name).\"

title: Ai quality analyst (portgugal portuguese )
description:
Empresa está contratando Ai quality analyst (portgugal portuguese ) em palmas. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Company Description: Million Logics is a trusted Oracle Partner and global leader in IT solutions, with operations in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. Specialising in innovative and scalable services, Million Logics empowers enterprises through data & AI, cloud solutions, IT consulting, and custom application development. With a team of 85+ AI/ML experts, we deliver tailored solutions that foster digital transformation and operational excellence. We are committed to client success. We blend world-class technical expertise with strategic insight to deliver results. Role Overview: As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and You Tube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions such as Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness. Offer Details: Duration of Contract: 6 months Pay: $1500 per month (net/take-home) Mode of work: Fully Remote Number of Positions: 20 Must have fluency in Portgutal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese ) Skills: Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred. BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field). Key Qualifications: Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portgutal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese ) with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project. Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (Sx S) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and over-narrating. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection. Description: In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied. Analysing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"over-narrating\". Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (Sx S) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history. Education & Experience: BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field). Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred. Additional Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type: Contractor Engagement Length: 6 months

title: Senior java developer
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior java developer em boa vista. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

A VMetrix é uma plataforma Saa S que atende instituições financeiras na América Latina. Processamos fluxos transacionais complexos, pipelines de dados de alto volume e integrações em tempo real — tudo construído sobre uma stack Java/Spring Boot + Oracle implantada na Oracle Cloud. Buscamos desenvolvedores Java sólidos que escrevam código excelente, pensem em sistemas e adotem o desenvolvimento assistido por IA como parte central do seu fluxo de trabalho. Propósito do Cargo Como Senior Java Developer, você vai construir e manter serviços backend e módulos de plataforma que suportam operações críticas de negócio. Você não precisa de experiência prévia no domínio financeiro — nós ensinamos. O que precisamos é de um desenvolvedor que escreva Java limpo e performante, domine padrões de design, entenda sistemas distribuídos e use ferramentas como Claude Code para se mover rápido sem sacrificar qualidade. Responsabilidades Principais: Desenvolvimento Backend Projetar, construir e manter serviços backend em Java 8+/Spring Boot: APIs REST, jobs de processamento batch, pipelines de transformação de dados e camadas de integração. Escrever código limpo, bem testado e pronto para produção, aplicando princípios SOLID, padrões de design (Strategy, Factory, Observer, Builder, Template Method, entre outros) e as diretrizes arquiteturais da equipe. Ser dono de features end-to-end: desde o design técnico até a implementação, testes, code review e deploy em produção. Otimizar o desempenho de aplicações: identificar e resolver gargalos em queries, chamadas a serviços, uso de memória e throughput. Aplicar corretamente padrões de concorrência e gerenciamento de threads em Java para operações paralelas e assíncronas. Design e Arquitetura Participar de decisões de design de software: seleção de padrões, definição de contratos entre componentes, separação de responsabilidades e modelagem de domínios. Aplicar princípios de design orientado a objetos (encapsulamento, herança, composição, polimorfismo) e design por contrato na construção de módulos. Contribuir para o design de arquiteturas limpas: separação de camadas (controller, service, repository), injeção de dependências, inversão de controle e baixo acoplamento entre módulos. Avaliar trade-offs técnicos entre diferentes abordagens de design, documentando decisões e suas justificativas. Banco de Dados e Integrações Trabalhar com Oracle Database: escrever e otimizar consultas SQL, stored procedures e packages PL/SQL para operações intensivas em dados. Construir e manter integrações com sistemas externos via APIs REST, cobrindo ingestão, transformação e sincronização de dados. Projetar padrões de acesso a dados eficientes usando JPA/Hibernate ou JDBC, com atenção a gerenciamento de conexões, cache de entidades e limites transacionais. Implementar estratégias de resiliência em integrações: retentativas, circuit breakers, timeouts e tratamento gracioso de falhas. Infraestrutura e Deploy Implantar e gerenciar aplicações em Kubernetes (OKE) com contêineres Docker e servidor de aplicações Web Logic. Trabalhar com pipelines CI/CD (Git Lab CI ou similar) para fluxos automatizados de build, teste e deployment. Diagnosticar problemas em produção: analisar logs, métricas de aplicação e comportamento do sistema para resolver incidentes. Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA Usar Claude Code como ferramenta principal de desenvolvimento: geração de código, refatoração, debugging, escrita de testes e exploração de codebases desconhecidos. Escrever e manter documentação técnica em Markdown que sirva como contexto de alta qualidade tanto para ferramentas de IA quanto para a equipe. Aplicar habilidades de engenharia de prompts: decompor problemas complexos em prompts claros e acionáveis, avaliando criticamente as saídas geradas por IA. Contribuir para as práticas de desenvolvimento com IA da equipe: compartilhar padrões eficazes, identificar limitações e ajudar a estabelecer melhores práticas. Colaboração e Crescimento Participar de revisões de código com feedback construtivo e rigoroso, focado em corretude, legibilidade, padrões e manutenibilidade. Mentorar desenvolvedores junior através de pair programming, discussões de design e transferência de conhecimento. Contribuir para discussões técnicas sobre arquitetura, ferramentas e melhorias de processos.
